::: {.resource-hero}
## Learn a skill. Put it to work.

These field guides offer practical, research-informed starting points
for reading, research, writing, and communication. Each guide explains
a core idea, walks through a step-by-step process with templates and
examples, flags common pitfalls, and lists sources for further reading.
The separate **Practicing the Skills** module provides exercises,
templates, and an ethical AI checklist.

[Explore practice activities](practicing.qmd){.resource-cta}
:::

## Browse the field guides

The guides are ordered to follow a typical study or research project,
from reading and finding sources through writing and sharing, then
ethical tool use and practice. Each one stands alone, so you can start
wherever you are.


## Who these resources are for

These guides are written for undergraduate students in any discipline,
and they are useful for early-career researchers too. They are not tied
to a course, assignment, discipline, laboratory, or required software
package. Examples come from a range of fields, and each guide links to
the others so you can follow a skill from reading to research to
writing and sharing.
